units.source_text: 许多四位、五位的大官员恭恭敬敬地随从着内大臣，

en.t: Many officials of the fourth and fifth ranks respectfully followed the Minister of the Interior,

units.source_text: 他的一举一动，都有无限威势。

en.t: and every movement he made carried boundless authority.

units.source_text: 近江君目送父亲归去，对五节君言道：

en.t: Omi no Kimi watched her father leave, then said to Go-sechi no Kimi:

units.source_text: “啊呀呀，我的父亲真好威风！

en.t: “Oh my, my father is truly imposing!

units.source_text: 我是这位大人物的女儿，却在穷乡僻壤的小户人家生长……”

en.t: I am the daughter of such a great man, yet I grew up in a humble household in a remote backwater...”

units.source_text: 五节君说：“内大臣太高贵了，教人不敢亲近。

en.t: Go-sechi no Kimi said, “The Minister of the Interior is so exalted that one hardly dares approach him.

units.source_text: 倘是个普通身份的父亲，接你回来，真心地疼爱你，倒反而更亲切呢。”

en.t: If he were a father of ordinary rank who brought you home and loved you sincerely, that might actually feel warmer.”

units.source_text: 此种想法，却也古怪。

en.t: That way of thinking was rather odd too.

units.source_text: 近江君骂道：“你又来和我捣蛋了，真讨厌啊！

en.t: Omi no Kimi snapped, “There you go troubling me again. How hateful!

units.source_text: 以后不许和我对嘴对舌！

en.t: From now on, you must not talk back to me!

units.source_text: 我是身份高贵的人呀！”

en.t: I am a person of noble rank!”

units.source_text: 她那娇嗔之相十分动人。

en.t: Her pouting, petulant manner was very charming.

units.source_text: 任性不拘，口没遮拦，亦自有其可爱之处，这缺陷倒可原谅。

en.t: Her willful freedom and unguarded speech had their own loveliness, so those faults could be forgiven.

units.source_text: 只是这位小姐生长在偏僻地方下等人之中，故不懂得言语之道。

en.t: But this young lady had grown up among lowly people in a remote place, and so she did not understand the art of speech.

units.source_text: 原来言语有一种技法：

en.t: For speech, after all, has its own technique:

units.source_text: 即使是无甚意思的言语，只要从容不迫、斯文一脉地说出，别人听来自然悦耳；

en.t: even words with little meaning sound naturally pleasant to others if spoken calmly and with refinement;

units.source_text: 即使是无甚深趣的诗歌，只要吟时声调恰当，余音婉转，首句和末句唱得缠绵悱恻，那么别人虽未深解诗歌的意义，听来自感兴味。

en.t: even a poem without much depth can feel engaging if it is recited in the right tone, with lingering resonance, and if the first and last lines are chanted with tender feeling, so that listeners are moved even without fully grasping the poem’s meaning.

units.source_text: 但近江君不懂此法，即使她所说的话含意甚深，听起来也全无趣味。

en.t: But Omi no Kimi did not understand this method, so even if what she said held deep meaning, it sounded utterly uninteresting.

units.source_text: 急忙地说出的话，使人只听见生硬枯燥的声音。

en.t: Words rushed out in haste made people hear only a stiff, dry voice.

units.source_text: 加之她的乳母性情蛮横，自命不凡，她在这乳母怀中长大起来，态度言行自然很不文雅，因此人品就低劣了。

en.t: Moreover, her nurse was overbearing by nature and thought highly of herself; having grown up in that nurse’s arms, Omi no Kimi naturally became inelegant in manner, speech, and conduct, and her character was diminished.

units.source_text: 但也并非一无所能，本末不称的三十一字短歌，她也能脱口而出地凑成。

en.t: Still, she was not entirely without ability: she could toss off a thirty-one-syllable waka, though its beginning and ending did not quite match.
